page.overview:
What is Hunt for Cassian Andor?

The hunt for Cassian Andor was a hunt took place in 5 BBY. ISB Supervisor Dedra Meero organised the hunt for the criminal Cassian Jeron Andor for his role in the ambush on Ferrix and his links to the rebel operative Axis.

When she arrived, she set up an active base in the Ferrix main city. Before she arrived, Dedra Meero had questioned former Preox-Morlana Deputy Inspector Syril Karn to find out any information about Andor. The Imperial forces were initially unaware that Andor was already incarcerated under a false name on the moon Narkina 5.

Following the death of Andor's adopted mother, Maarva, Meero organized trap to catch Andor during Maarva's funeral procession. However, the subsequent riot resulted in Meero's failure, allowing Andor to evade capture and formally join the Axis network.

By 3 BBY, newly-promoted Supervisor Avril Heert was assigned the Axis desk while Meero was reassigned to the Ghorman project. Unwilling to give up her search for Andor, and by extension Axis, Meero stressed to Heert the importance of finding Andor. Unbeknownst to the ISB, Andor was in fact hiding under their noses on Coruscant.
